method: Regenerated with the repository generator in real headless Chrome on Linux. Every current PNG SHA-256 indexed. Each frame is bound to the labelled sheet that showed its exact bytes: unchanged LEFT017B sheets, or new LEFT017D sheets covering every distinct image not shown before. One Dark Pro and Dracula focus/boundary frames were also viewed at original size. No full PNGs tracked.
